barcelona-catalonia-cap-de-creus-coastal.story: Scenery first, traffic last, with checkpoints that make sense on a bike. A 198 km loop that starts and ends near Castelldefels, about 3 h 36 of riding. sections.to: Photo stop near Castellar del Vallès
sections.advice: Scenic stretch in Ullastrell → Photo stop near Castellar del Vallès is the reward section in Barcelona. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.from: Photo stop near Castellar del Vallès
sections.advice: Photo stop near Castellar del Vallès → Canet de Mar is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

scenicChapters.title: Monserrat Mountain Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 24 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
